_comment: mini-dudeai MeshAnchor NOC seed — the MA twin of MeshForge's federator/gateway seeds. MeshAnchor's fleet-watchdog (monitoring/fleet_watchdog.py) records blackouts to SQLite (monitoring/fleet_history.py, table blackout_events); the meshanchor_fleet preset's BlackoutDbSource projects each ACTIVE blackout to a signal_class Condition whose extras.class is the blackout kind ∈ {no_data, http_dead, frozen, daemon_dead, role_drift}. These rules match on that class exactly as MeshForge's seeds match watchdog signal classes. Boot-health (unexpected_reboot) and source_error (health-surface blindness) are wired the same as MeshForge. Per-box file at ~/mini_dudeai_rules.json; the daemon promotes ~/mini_dudeai_rules.json.candidate over it on the next tick. Repo canonical for backup + re-deploy parity. Observation-only: mini proposes, it never ratifies.

rules.annotation: fleet_watchdog daemon_dead — the meshanchor-daemon/fleet-watchdog is inactive. Recovery: systemctl status the unit, restart if wedged; check journal for the crash cause.
fleet_watchdog no_data — no fresh heartbeat/collector data within the stale threshold. Check the collector unit and its data path.
fleet_watchdog http_dead — the local map/API is not responding. Restart meshanchor-map; if it recurs, look for the GIL-bound serialization wedge class (MeshForge #70/#71 twin).
fleet_watchdog frozen — heartbeat present but the underlying data has not advanced across the frozen window. A live-but-stuck producer; check the collector's source, not just its liveness.
fleet_watchdog role_drift — the box's live units diverge from its declared role (deployment.json / fleet_roles.yaml). Fix: provision_role.py --apply. Escalate-only (low urgency, operator-paced).

FederationPeerSource — a peer this box's MA map federates with is in_backoff or errored (per-vantage: how meshanchor-server sees its peers). Escalate-only (degraded, not an outage — matches MeshForge's map-running-box policy). Only active when MINI_DUDEAI_ENABLE_FEDERATION=1 (opt-in, on the map-running server).

BootHealthSource — the box reset without a clean-exit marker (unplanned power event or crash). Planned reboots stay silent (the engine stamps the marker on graceful stop). Check dmesg/journal for the cause.

fleet_watchdog mini_dead — the mini's own state file went stale (the second brain died/wedged). The EXTERNAL watcher (fleet_watchdog) already pages this at 'high'; this rule is escalate-only to avoid a double-page if a recovered mini later processes the still-open blackout. If the mini is dead it can't process this at all — that is exactly why fleet_watchdog, not the mini, is the primary pager for mini_dead.

MiniSelfSource — the live ~/mini_dudeai_rules.json is missing rule(s) the repo seed carries (box deployed/bumped but never re-seeded). Escalate-only (operator-paced): re-seed from configs/mini_dudeai_rules.ma_noc.json or promote the candidate. This rule matches its OWN class, so a box missing THIS rule can't report its own drift until re-seeded once — expected bootstrap gap.

A mini source could not read its health surface (e.g. the blackout DB is unreadable). Blindness is page-worthy — absence of blackouts read through a broken channel must NOT be mistaken for health (honest_failure_modes #2).
